div.i: The plant page of Tutorial 15.3. The card sets the trailing figure at December 2026 beside the 2024 level, and its title says that December 2026 is provisional: direct time and output run to December 11, 2026, and indirect time to December 4, 2026, so the ratio is an observed-records diagnostic, not a labor efficiency variance. The (Blank) work center holds the few direct lines without an operation.
